notes: Company background: Pegatrix builds an enterprise search layer for regulated legal and financial corpora. Customers include law firms and compliance teams.
Primary ask: scalable embeddings + reranking pipeline capable of 100M-1B vectors; predictable P95 latency <50ms for retrieve phase, <200ms end-to-end with reranker for top-10.
Workload profile: heavy fanout on retrieval (topK=1k in initial candidate generation), then cross-encoder rerank on top-30. Expect bursts around e-discovery jobs (spikes x5).
Cost sensitivity: unit-cost per query is a key purchasing metric. "Low-per-query" target: <$0.002 per query at 250M vectors baseline, with aggressive batching/caching to hit goals.
Model preferences: prefer open embedding models (ada/variant-style) for CPU/quantize, and a compact cross-encoder (T5-small-ish) for reranker but open to offloading to GPU for latency-critical flows.
Indexing requirements: incremental ingestion, shingling (sliding window embedding), live deletes/PII redaction, and reindex windows every 24-48h for source connectors.
Operational needs: per-route cost & latency dashboards, token-level cost breakdown, automatic fallback to cheaper model variants during peak.
Security/compliance: must support SSO/SAML, KMS integration (customer-managed), audit logging retention 7 years, and data residency in US-EAST or on-prem option for specific clients.
Quote from CTO on 2026-03-01 call: "We can trade off a little latency for 10x cost reduction, but we cannot tolerate unpredictable tail latency."
SE notes: Focus on batching strategy (dynamic batch sizes), prefix/KV cache reuse for conversational overlays, and vector compression/8-bit quantization for storage savings.
Open questions: exact vector dimensionality after shingling, expected average query QPS (they estimated 500-3,000 QPS depending on clients), and SLA thresholds for e-discovery workflows.
Requested artifacts: POC plan + ingestion checklist, Dedicated cluster sizing + estimated per-query cost model, security/architecture diagram for on-prem connector.
Sales friction: procurement wants a fixed unit price for at-scale retrieval+rerank; legal requires proof of residency before starting full ingest.
Notes shorthand: POC=250M vectors -> baseline run; metric targets: storage cost, cost/query, P95 latency retrieve+rerank, reranker GPU utilization.
technical_requirements: Retrieve phase targets: P95 <50ms for ANN lookup (dedicated hw), recall@100 >0.92 on sample eval set.
Rerank phase targets: end-to-end P95 <200ms for top-10 re-ranked responses, model budgeted to run on GPU for critical flows.
Storage/compression: support product-quantization or 8-bit quantization to reduce footprint by 4x-8x.
Batching/caching: automatic dynamic batching, prefix and KV cache reuse for conversational overlays, candidate caching for frequent queries.
Throughput planning: sustain steady-state QPS 1,000 with bursts to 5,000; autoscale/burst options required.
Data lifecycle: live deletes, reindex schedule, retention windows, and PII redaction hooks.
Observability: per-route token costs, per-request latency breakdown, traceable reranker decisions for QA.
